description: This file defines an 'embed' node for a rich text editor, including its attributes, rendering, and commands for inserting and updating embedded content.

classes.name: EmbedNode
classes.description: A Tiptap Node extension for embedding content such as iframes, with attributes for source, size, and alignment, and commands for manipulation.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Provides default options for the embed node, such as HTML attributes.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Defines the group this node belongs to, here 'block'.

methods.name: addAttributes
methods.description: Specifies the attributes for the embed node, including src, width, height, and align.

methods.name: parseHTML
methods.description: Defines how to parse HTML elements into this node, specifically iframe tags with src attribute.

methods.name: renderHTML
methods.description: Renders the node as an iframe HTML element with merged attributes.

methods.name: addNodeView
methods.description: Creates a React-based node view for the embed, with update logic based on attribute changes.

methods.name: addCommands
methods.description: Provides commands to insert an embed, set alignment, size, and source.
